preflight_steps.detail: log2fc / mean_diff are full-window means over all positions x tracks (see score_definitions)

units: log2((ALT+1)/(REF+1)), pseudocount 1 in model-native track units

score_definitions.log2fc: mean over ALL positions of the 16,384-bp window and ALL tracks returned for the ontology term(s) of log2((ALT+1)/(REF+1)). A full-window mean dilutes a local effect (the Borzoi SAD lesson); a value near 0 means no window-wide shift, not no effect.
score_definitions.mean_diff: mean over the same positions x tracks of (ALT - REF) in model-native RNA_SEQ coverage units. Positive = ALT predicted higher.
